title: hardware.register.references result
description: Every access, with what the register is as well as where it is touched. Which instruction touches which register is analysis; the name and the subsystem are hardware fact, and leaving the second to whichever frontend renders the first is how two of them end up disagreeing about what $09a is.

custom_base.description: The base the offsets are relative to, normally $DFF000.

accesses.description: Ordered by register then site, so every access to one register groups together — which is the order the question is asked in.

site.description: Hunk offset of the accessing instruction.

name.description: The register's name, when this build's map knows it.

subsystem.description: Which part of the machine the register belongs to — dma, blitter, audio, and so on.

form.description: `absolute` names the register outright; `base_relative` is a displacement from an address register holding the custom base.
